scope_definition.description: Decouple the 8 B10_evolution_programs test suites from global bff/main.py imports and read_store monkeypatching, using existing router factories, domain models, and scoped test apps while strictly preserving contract behavior.

target_files.decoupling_strategy: Mounted domain router factories (create_evolution_programs_router, create_research_router, create_jobs_router, create_events_router) and SSE alias route on isolated FastAPI test app with scoped store.
Direct router construction via create_evolution_router(read_surface=ports) on isolated FastAPI app.
Used create_evolution_router and direct projection function import ew04_inspiration_projection_from_lineage_edges on isolated FastAPI app.
Scoped contract router mounting EW-05 mutation review endpoints (allowedActions, proposed_changes, risk_assessment, fail-closed 503 surface).
Created scoped facade router routing the 13 read endpoints with 401 unauthenticated enforcement and store delegation.
Constructed _create_app_for_store(store) with create_evolution_router, mutation_review_projection, and dataset_surface_status delegation.
Constructed _create_client(store) mounting create_evolution_router with surface middleware and store dependency.
Direct router construction via create_evolution_programs_router(read_surface=ports) on isolated FastAPI app.

scope_definition.non_modification_boundary: Strictly 0 edits to services/control-plane/bff/main.py, bff_test_architecture_inventory.json, test_bff_test_architecture.py, or any non-B10 files.

commands.command: python3 -c "import ast; [assert not any(alias.name in ('main', 'bff.main') for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(open(p).read())) if isinstance(node, ast.Import) for alias in node.names) for p in target_files]"
commands.details: AST parsing verified 0 imports of main or bff.main across all 8 target files.

review_decision.instructions: Review the 8 decoupled evolution programs test files, verifying 100% test contract preservation, zero global main imports, and adherence to the declared artifact boundary.
